The lack of inpatient beds leading to the unacceptable wait time in A&E for those suffering with their mental health who are awaiting a psychiatric beds
In Sapphire's case a bed was not found for her within a 19-day period
The unsuitability of the environment of A&E as a holding place for those in need of a mental health bed
unsuitable A&E environment for mental health patients

The evidence was that the environment in A&E as a holding place is not conducive for those suffering with Autism and/or who are neurodiverse. The environment in A&E can exacerbate and cause further deterioration in their mental health
A&E environment harmful to autistic and neurodiverse patients

This is a second recent Inquest that I have heard where a death occurred following a lengthy wait in A&E for a psychiatric bed. In both cases the patients were transgender and had a diagnosis of autistic spectrum disorder
repeat deaths due to A&E psychiatric bed waits affecting transgender autistic patients
